summary: Many economic and financial relationships may change gradually rather than abruptly. title: Capacity Confounds and Coverage Guarantees in Adaptive Sub-model Federated Learning
summary: Sub-model federated learning lets resource-constrained clients train width-reduced versions of a global model, but existing methods allocate capacity by device resources alone.
